step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram features two main flows: data ingestion into an S3 data lake and an ML processing pipeline driven by SageMaker. Data from RDS, Kinesis, and BigQuery is ingested via AWS Glue into S3. Data scientists interact with SageMaker within a VPC, using IAM for role-based access control. SageMaker triggers a Lambda function to pull custom containers from Amazon ECR, and output results are written back to the S3 data lake.
